newsitem.title: USA: Transkaryotic files for 1mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Transkaryotic files for 1mln shr offering.

text.p: Transkaryotic Therapies Inc said Thursday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer one million shares.

The company said it plans to withdraw the offering --which is made to institutional investors only-- if it receives no interest for substantially all of the securities at an acceptable price before July 31.
The company posted a $3.8 million loss on revenues of $5.2 million in the first quarter, compared with a $1.4 million loss on $3.7 million in revenues the year before.
